title: Stress test
pitch: Watch a synthetic thirty-two-worker workload with session counters, CPU trends and captured output.
makeItYours: Replace the sample ticks with updates from your worker queue.
Connect session counters and CPU samples to your own workload.
Keep third-party output in the captured log while workers post updates.
useCase: Use it when a busy worker pool must remain readable while updates and tool output arrive together.
